BC_description: The `Command.parse()` method now treats excess command-line arguments as errors by default. Previously, excess arguments (arguments not declared in the command definition) were silently allowed. The default value of the 'allowExcessArguments' setting has changed from true to false in Commander v13.0.0.
Adaptation_method: To handle this breaking change, either: 1) Declare all expected arguments in your command definition using `program.argument('[args...]', 'description')`, or 2) Explicitly allow excess arguments by calling `program.allowExcessArguments()` before parsing.
